Key observations from the test image:
- Corn plant with reddish-brown discoloration on some leaves
- One prominent leaf shows strong reddish-brown streaking/coloration
- Some leaves appear to have elongated lesions or streaking patterns
- Plants seem to be partially lodged/bent

Top candidates: Goss_wilt, Stewarts_wilt, Anthracnose_leaf_spot_top_dieback, Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma

Let me view reference images for these candidates.
Now let me view one more reference to help differentiate:

**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Tall corn plants at mid-late season growth stage
- One prominent leaf showing diffuse reddish-brown/orange-brown coloration (whole leaf color change)
- Other leaves appear slightly yellowed or pale
- Some plants appear slightly lodged/drooping

**Comparing to Reference Images:**

| Candidate | Match | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma | ✓✓ | Reddish-purple/reddish-brown leaf coloration is characteristic; leaves turn yellow then reddish-purple with age |
| Goss_wilt | Partial | Would show large tan/brown water-soaked lesions with diagnostic freckles — freckles not visible |
| Anthracnose_stalk_rot | Partial | Top dieback with grey/brown dying; stalk shiny black — can't confirm stalk symptoms |
| Northern_corn_leaf_blight | ✗ | Requires distinct cigar-shaped tan lesions — not what's visible |
| Stewarts_wilt | ✗ | Reference showed seedlings; yellow streaks with wavy margins — doesn't match diffuse reddening |
| Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus | ✗ | White/pale longitudinal striping — doesn't match |

**Key reasoning:** The most prominent feature is the diffuse reddish-brown to reddish-purple coloration of an entire leaf, with other leaves showing some yellowing. This whole-leaf color change (not discrete lesions) is most characteristic of **Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma**, where leaves progressively turn yellow then reddish to reddish-purple with age. While severe stunting isn't obviously confirmed from this field perspective angle, the leaf discoloration pattern is the strongest diagnostic signal.
